analysis: Line movement flagged a genuine reverse line move this afternoon: BookMaker.eu has now tightened from -7.0 at open to -5.0, and Caesars-via-VegasInsider shows -4.5, even though 69% of both bets and handle at cleatz.com are on Green Bay -- the market is moving toward Atlanta despite the public leaning the other way, which is a real sharp-money signal rather than a lopsided-ticket illusion (handle and bets agree here, so it is not a classic bets-vs-handle split, but the direction against the heavy public side is the notable part). The spread itself still offers no clean edge -- the injury-adjusted sim margin (5.1) and the current market (-4.5 to -6.0 depending on book) are close enough that the RLM is a signal to watch line direction into kickoff, not yet a bet in itself.

The total remains the one angle with real separation: the sim projects 36.1 points adjusted for the five combined injuries (four Packers, three Falcons) against a market sitting at 43.0-44.5, and BookMaker.eu has shaved 2 points off its total since Monday. Final injury reports from SI/Yahoo this afternoon confirmed the same players already priced in (Banks, Bako-Bewele, Brinson, Reed out for Green Bay; Ebukam out and Terrell on IR for Atlanta) -- no new names, so the injury picture is settled ahead of kickoff. With Atlanta averaging just 3 points last week and both offenses down key contributors, the Under continues to be the strongest lean on the board.
